2.4.7 Callback Notifications
In AUTOSAR, a “callback” is defined as functionality in an upper-layer BSW module that is called by a lower-layer module in order to provide notification as required[3]. Modeling Guidelines of Basic Software EA UML Model Figure 2.9: Difference between a callback and a regular function call
